title: The bomb they made smaller to be safe
caption:
They cut it in half to be safe. It was still the biggest explosion in history. ☢️
Tsar Bomba was tested at about 50 megatons in 1961, half its 100-megaton design, and fell under a giant parachute so the plane could escape.
What's the most 'safe' unsafe thing you've ever seen?
sources: Wikipedia, Tsar Bomba (30 October 1961; ~50 Mt test of a 100 Mt design; cloud top about 64-67 km; parachute; the Tu-95 dropped about 1 km)
Rosatom archive / Atomic Heritage Foundation, Tsar Bomba
